status: WRITTEN exact nonnegative slack identity for the product-projector part of the singular boundary, UNREVIEWED
identity: For P=|v⟩⟨v|⊗Q, rank Q=2, X=A⊗I+I⊗B with Tr A=Tr B=0, set a=⟨v,Av⟩, b=Tr(QB), dA=||A||F²−||Av||², U=||BQ||F², V=||B(I−Q)||F². Then exactly 2L−Tr(PX†X)=2(dA−|a|²/3)+(U−|b|²/2)+2(V−|b|²/2)+(√(2/3)|a|−√(3/2)|b|)²+2(|ab|−Re(conjugate(a)b)). Every summand is nonnegative by tracezero Cauchy, elementary norms and phase alignment. No numerical or q instance.
exact_equality: All terms vanish iff for some a and u⊥v, A=a|v⟩⟨v|−(a/3)(I−|v⟩⟨v|)+|u⟩⟨v| and B=(a/3)(2Q−I), including a=0. Swap factors for P=Q⊗|v⟩⟨v|.
limits: Strengthens only the already-proved singular-boundary subcase. The D>0,N>0,J≠0 contraction and unrestricted T2/T3/Z2/q3 remain unproved.
